step1_analysis.description: A low-voltage current-mode sense amplifier for nonvolatile memories. It uses a negative feedback loop formed by cross-coupled current mirrors to regulate the bitline voltage and compare the memory cell current against a reference current.

paper_reference.title: A High-Performance Very Low-Voltage Current Sense Amplifier for Nonvolatile Memories

read_access_time.description: Delay from the activation of the memory cell current to the output voltage crossing the decision threshold.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming a bitline capacitance Cbl = 1pF, a half-swing dV = 0.24V, and a charging current I = 5uA. The delay t = C * dV / I = 1pF * 0.24V / 5uA = 48ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the assumed bitline capacitance and reference current. Adjusted for 1pF load and 10uA reference current.

power_consumption.description: Average power drawn from the supply during a read operation.

sky130_expected.calculation: Total current is I_ref + I_12. If I_ref = 10uA and I_cell = 0, I_12 = 15uA. Total current = 25uA. Power = 25uA * 1.8V = 45uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Higher than the paper's reported values due to the 1.8V supply and assumed 10uA reference current (the paper likely used ~1uA and a 1V supply).

bitline_voltage_swing.description: Voltage difference on the bitline between programmed and erased states.

sky130_expected.calculation: When I_cell = 0, BL is at Vgs of XM1 with 5uA. Vgs = Vth + sqrt(2*Id / (un*Cox * W/L)) = 0.42 + sqrt(10u / (270u * 10)) = 0.48V. When I_cell = 20uA, BL is discharged to 0V. Swing = 0.48V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using SKY130 NMOS parameters. The swing is clamped by the diode-connected NMOS to keep the bitline voltage low and improve speed.

sky130_expected.calculation: Standard nominal voltage for sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 is 1.8V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adapted to SKY130 standard 1.8V devices, though the current-mode topology allows it to operate at much lower voltages.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure read access time, power consumption, and voltage swings of the current sense amplifier.
step3_testbench.spice:
* High-Performance Very Low-Voltage Current Sense Amplifier
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
Iref VDD N1 DC 10u
* Voltage source to control the cell current (1V = 1uA)
Vcell_ctrl ctrl 0 DC 5 AC 1 PULSE(0 20 10n 1n 1n 40n 80n)
Gcell BL 0 ctrl 0 1u
Cbl BL 0 1p

XM11 N2 N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM13 BL N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM10 N1 N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM1 BL BL GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM14 N1 BL GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}
XM12 N2 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}

.control
* DC Analysis
dc Vcell_ctrl 0 20 0.1
meas dc bl_high find v(BL) at=0
meas dc bl_low find v(BL) at=20
meas dc n2_high max v(N2)
meas dc n2_low min v(N2)

* AC Analysis
ac dec 10 1k 1G
meas ac z_bl_db find vdb(BL) at=1k
meas ac z_n2_db find vdb(N2) at=1k

* Transient Analysis
tran 0.1n 100n
meas tran t_read_fall trig v(ctrl) val=10 rise=1 targ v(BL) val=0.24 fall=1
meas tran t_read_rise trig v(ctrl) val=10 fall=1 targ v(BL) val=0.24 rise=1
meas tran pwr_avg avg -i(VVDD)*1.8

quit
.endc
